question: Find the effective price percentage of the marked price after three consecutive discounts of 8%, 17% and 17%. (Rounded up to two decimal places.)
solution:
**Given:**

Discounts = 8%, 17%, 17%

**Formula used:**

Effective Price% = 100 × (1 - (d₁)/(100)) times (1 - (d₂)/(100)) times (1 - (d₃)/(100))
